name: Watermelon Bacterial Fruit Blotch
description: A serious bacterial disease that causes water-soaked lesions on watermelon fruits, leading to fruit rot and cracking. It is seed-borne and can be devastating in warm, humid conditions.
symptoms: Water-soaked spots on upper leaf surfaces
Dark green irregular lesions on fruit rind
Fruit lesions turning brown and cracking
Internal fruit decay following rind infection
Red-brown discoloration of vascular tissue in seedlings
causes: Seed-borne bacteria surviving on seed coat
Rain splash and overhead irrigation spreading bacteria
treatments: No effective cure once symptoms appear on fruit
Remove and destroy infected plants and fruits promptly
Reduce overhead irrigation to minimize spread
prevention: Treat seeds with hot water (50°C for 30 min) or hydrochloric acid treatment
Avoid overhead irrigation — use drip irrigation
Practice crop rotation with non-cucurbit crops
Remove volunteer cucurbits and crop debris
